# Contoso DIY

*Disclaimer: This content is generated by AI and may not accurately represent factual information about any real entity. Use this information with caution and verify details from reliable sources.*

## History

Contoso DIY is a fictional home improvement retailer founded in 1985. It supplies tools, building materials, and project essentials to homeowners and professional contractors through seven Washington retail stores and an online store.

| Year | Milestone |
|------|-----------|
| 1985 | Opened the first home improvement store in Seattle |
| 1990 | Expanded the tool and building-materials catalog |
| 2000 | Launched an online store for DIY and contractor supplies |
| 2015 | Expansion into sustainable and eco-friendly product lines |

## Company Overview

At Contoso DIY, store operations, inventory, procurement, and customer support teams work together to help customers complete their projects. Our retail stores serve Seattle, Bellevue, Tacoma, Spokane, Everett, Redmond, and Kirkland, alongside our online store.

### Core Values

- **Innovation:** Improving how customers find products and complete their projects.
- **Diversity:** Embracing different perspectives for creative excellence.
- **Sustainability:** Committed to eco-friendly practices in our products.
